zh.title: Knockbots：机器人格斗
zh.summary: 操纵机器人进入三维竞技场，练习拳脚与格挡。
zh.action: 等待竞技场加载，选择 Training 或 Arcade，然后按页面提示操作。
zh.why: 金属机体和工业场景为浏览器格斗增添了鲜明的视觉风格。
zh.limit: 加载可能需要时间；本机只核验了游戏菜单，完整对战和手机未测。

en.title: Knockbots
en.summary: Step into a 3D robot arena and practice punches, kicks and blocks.
en.action: Allow the arena to load, choose Training or Arcade, and follow the controls.
en.why: Metal fighters and an industrial arena give this browser brawler a distinct look.
en.limit: Loading can take time; we verified the game menu, not a complete match or mobile support.

verification.note: 本机加载出三维角色与游戏菜单；Grok 报告曾在其浏览器进入训练回合。
verification.note_en: The 3D fighters and game menu loaded locally; Grok reported entering a training round in its browser.

zh.title: Lili and the Last Door：莉莉与最后一扇门
zh.summary: 跟随戴着女巫帽的莉莉，走进一个停在午夜的像素冒险。
zh.action: 等待游戏加载，按键开始并选择 New Game；可按 Esc 跳过开场。
zh.why: 像素场景、角色对话和万圣节氛围组成了一段叙事旅程。
zh.limit: 本机进入序章对话；未完成完整故事或手机测试。

en.title: Lili and the Last Door
en.summary: Follow a young witch through a pixel-art adventure on a night stuck at midnight.
en.action: Wait for the game to load, press a key and choose New Game; Esc skips the opening.
en.why: Pixel scenes, character dialogue and a Halloween setting shape a story-led adventure.
en.limit: We reached the opening dialogue but did not complete the story or test mobile.

verification.note: 本机进入序章并看到角色对话；完整故事及手机未测。
verification.note_en: A desktop browser reached the opening chapter and character dialogue; the full story and mobile remain untested.

zh.title: Afterlight：余晖
zh.summary: 在有光影的三维场景里，跟随像素角色开启一段世界末日后的冒险。
zh.action: 等待标题画面，使用键盘选择 New Game 和难度，再按提示推进对话。
zh.why: 像素角色与立体场景结合，一段成长故事从灯塔小镇展开。
zh.limit: 首次加载可能较慢；完整故事及手机体验尚未核验。

en.title: Afterlight
en.summary: Follow pixel-art characters through a lit 3D world in a post-apocalyptic adventure.
en.action: Wait for the title screen, use the keyboard to choose New Game and a difficulty, then follow the dialogue.
en.why: Pixel characters and 3D dioramas bring to life a coming-of-age story that begins in a lighthouse town.
en.limit: Initial loading can be slow; the full story and mobile experience have not been verified.

verification.note: Grok 在云端桌面进入序章并截取游戏画面；本机确认原站响应，手机未测。
verification.note_en: Grok entered and captured the prologue in a desktop browser; the original site responded locally, and mobile was not tested.

zh.title: Felt World：针毡世界
zh.summary: 在像毛线和针毡做成的世界里开车、步行、飞行或潜水。
zh.action: 选择 Start 进入世界，使用 W 开车；按 H 查看操作说明。
zh.why: 拼布道路、毡质树木和海底场景组成一座可以自由探索的手作世界。
zh.limit: 图形表现依赖设备与外部资源；手机体验尚未核验。

en.title: Felt World
en.summary: Drive, walk, fly or dive through a world that looks stitched from felt and yarn.
en.action: Choose Start to enter, use W to drive and press H for controls.
en.why: Patchwork roads, felt trees and underwater scenes form a playful world to explore.
en.limit: Graphics depend on device performance and external resources; mobile has not been verified.

verification.note: Grok 在云端桌面进入世界并开车；本机确认原站响应，手机未测。
verification.note_en: Grok entered the world and drove in a desktop browser; the original site responded locally, and mobile was not tested.

zh.title: Null Range：太空缠斗
zh.summary: 驾驶飞船进入共享星区，用声呐发现目标并在太空中机动。
zh.action: 填写显示名并选择 Deploy，按页面提示使用声呐、方向键和油门。
zh.why: 线框地形与第一人称座舱让太空对战呈现出鲜明的视觉风格。
zh.limit: 这是在线多人体验；完整对战和手机体验尚未核验。

en.title: Null Range
en.summary: Pilot a ship into a shared sector, use sonar and maneuver through space.
en.action: Enter a callsign, choose Deploy and follow the on-screen sonar and flight controls.
en.why: Wireframe terrain and a first-person cockpit give the space combat a distinctive look.
en.limit: This is an online multiplayer experience; full combat and mobile have not been verified.

description.zh: 赛事主办方公布了该作品的获奖信息，赛事当时要求参赛作品至少 90% 的代码由 AI 编写；具体工具来自对公开参赛资料的报道，我们尚未独立核对原始提交。
description.en: The organizer lists this as a Vibe Jam winner; the jam required at least 90% of each entry’s code to be AI-written. The tools listed here are reported from the public entry, which we have not independently inspected.

verification.note: Grok 在云端桌面进入星区并操作飞船；本机确认原站响应。AI 工具信息依据公开赛事提交资料的转述。
verification.note_en: Grok entered a sector and operated the ship in a desktop browser; the site responded locally. AI tool attribution is based on a published account of the jam submission.

zh.title: Kansō：盆栽庭园
zh.summary: 在安静的三维庭园里照料盆栽，观察树木随季节生长。
zh.action: 选择 Play，进入庭园后尝试浇水、修剪或调整树形。
zh.why: 把园艺中的细小动作和季节变化做成了一段舒缓的互动。
zh.limit: 本机尚未核验手机体验；作品可能使用浏览器本地存档。

en.title: Kansō
en.summary: Care for a bonsai in a quiet 3D garden and watch it grow with the seasons.
en.action: Choose Play, enter the garden and try watering, pruning or shaping the tree.
en.why: Small acts of gardening and changing seasons become a calm interactive experience.
en.limit: Mobile has not been verified locally; the game may use browser storage for saves.

description.zh: 赛事主办方公布了该作品的获奖信息，赛事当时要求参赛作品至少 90% 的代码由 AI 编写；具体工具来自对公开参赛资料的报道，我们尚未独立核对原始提交。
description.en: The organizer lists this as a Vibe Jam winner; the jam required at least 90% of each entry’s code to be AI-written. The tools listed here are reported from the public entry, which we have not independently inspected.

verification.note: Grok 在云端桌面进入庭园并开始照料盆栽；本机确认原站响应。工具列表依据公开赛事提交资料的转述。
verification.note_en: Grok entered the garden and began caring for a bonsai in a desktop browser; the site responded locally. The tool list comes from a published account of the jam submission.

zh.title: Web-Bayan：网页巴扬手风琴
zh.summary: 用键盘演奏一台浏览器里的巴扬手风琴，探索按钮、音栓和音色。
zh.action: 点击页面或按任意键进入，再使用电脑键盘或鼠标演奏圆形按钮。
zh.why: 左右键盘、音栓和八度控制将真实乐器的操作组织到同一个面板。
zh.limit: 声音需要一次交互才能启用；本机确认按键高亮，未实际听测音频或测试手机。

en.title: Web-Bayan
en.summary: Play a browser-based bayan accordion and explore its buttons, registers and sounds.
en.action: Click or press a key to begin, then use your computer keyboard or mouse to play the buttons.
en.why: Two keyboard clusters, registers and octave controls bring the instrument into one interface.
en.limit: Sound requires an initial gesture; key highlights were checked, but audio was not audibly verified and mobile was not tested.

verification.note: 本机打开乐器并按键，确认按钮高亮；音频未实际听测，手机未测。
verification.note_en: A desktop browser opened the instrument and confirmed key highlights; audio was not audibly verified and mobile was not tested.
